description: Record the durable residue of a COMPLETED task in the team-visible daily log: what someone arriving later needs in order not to redo it, dated state included. ALWAYS write the authored essence (only a frozen catalog without that field may omit it). If the person corrected you for re-litigating a decision, say so. If this work made a read memory's 'dies when' true, name it in fulfills and it is retired with this entry.

backfilled.description: true for history from BEFORE Arroway existed, not today's work.

content.description: What was decided, found or changed, and what it cost. You judge the length.

essence.description: One authored line with the operative result; never the opening of the body.

fulfills.description: Memories whose 'dies when' this work made true (decision/fact/reference received in full in a read). Never one that merely looks old.

how.description: What met the kill condition, in one sentence.

memory.description: The #handle from the read, or the full id.

keep_whole.description: true only after you considered cutting an indivisible oversized residue.

operational.description: true for HOW the work went (failures, measurements, self-corrections): kept for catch-up, out of task reads.

project.description: Project slug. Not from the person or a read this session? It is a guess: check the arroway_catch_up roster.

source.description: Optional pointer to a living source (URL, doc, CRM id)

name: arroway_log
title: Log what a task left behind
